description: This PHP source file defines the VacancyListViewController class within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. The controller manages the presentation of a vacancy list view by setting up a Vue component and a template, and implements the PublicControllerInterface.

classes.name: VacancyListViewController
classes.description: Controller responsible for rendering the vacancy list view, extending AbstractVueController and implementing PublicControllerInterface. Sets up a Vue component and a template for the vacancy list page.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view by creating a Vue component named 'vacancy-list' and sets the no_header.html.twig template for rendering.
